lines: Black water wells up through the peat. It is warm, like something breathed into it.

sign: Under the Choir the wax runs down into the dark. Something down there is counting the drips.
taper_clerk: Odette: Maudrey keeps the ledger of candles. I keep the ledger of Maudrey. Mine is shorter and much more interesting.
taper_clerk_intro: Odette: Your candle is on page nine. Let's see if we can turn the page.
taper_clerk_defeat: Odette: Still lit. I'll note it in pencil.

lines: I lit a candle for you this morning. Do not thank me. I lit it early so the wax would be ready for the next one.
Maudrey: The wax has stopped running. The Choir will have to sing for real now, not for the dead. They'll hate it.
Maudrey: Your candle? Ashby bought its burn time. Ask him how long he thinks you've got. He's betting.

maudrey_intro: I lit a candle for you this morning. Do not thank me. I lit it early so the wax would be ready for the next one.
maudrey_defeat: Still burning. How tiresome. I will have to sell the candle back to myself.
